sentence: This project builds chemical methods to detect diets and uses fossil plant material to learn how the Amazon rainforest responded to past climate extremes.
This project tests how seahorses and pipefish, which lost key parts of the adaptive immune system, respond to infection and keep immune memory.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that mark grammatical structures, word meanings, and references to people and places in early English books.
This project studies how chemistry instructors design and adapt assessments now that generative artificial intelligence tools can solve chemistry problems.
This project builds mathematical frameworks and quantum computing techniques to model and analyze the behavior of open quantum systems.
This project uses machine learning and smart testing stations to measure variability in cognitive performance between individuals in a primate model system.
This project tests ways to combine scientific and traditional local knowledge to help communities on Maui cope with and recover from wildfires.
This project builds a framework for construction robots to scan and create maps of highly dynamic and rapidly changing construction sites.
This project computationally designs complex enzymes inside engineered bacteria to make sturdy bioplastics that withstand high temperatures and can be recycled.
This project studies how fishes control their buoyancy using air breaths or a gas gland and how these ways evolved.
This project uses social media posts and machine learning to extract events around disasters and to analyze the spatial-temporal relationship between events.
This project puts artificial intelligence into robotics and semiconductor manufacturing to improve the efficiency of chip production.
This project develops a certificate program in bioscience data analysis that covers designing experiments and analyzing large data sets.
This project develops unsupervised deep learning methods that work with limited and corrupted imaging data and come with rigorous guarantees.
This project builds genomic resources for alpine bistort to find out how evolutionary processes contribute to ecological change in this plant.
This project builds methods that use network traffic and deep learning to find and study exploited devices connected to the Internet.
